attack_techniques: Credentials from Password Stores: Cloud Secrets Management Stores (T1555.006)
attackers_goals: Exfiltrate sensitive secrets stored in AWS SSM parameter store.
description: An attempt was made to retrieve parameters stored in AWS SSM.
investigative_actions: Investigate the purpose of the encrypted parameter and assess the sensitivity of its contents. Check if the access aligns with known workflows or automation, or if it indicates abnormal activity.
